what: D3.2 demo deployed on Streamlit Community Cloud and checked end to end
verified_with: headless Chrome (Playwright) against the public URL; spend read back from the store

checks.check: replay mode renders the sample question with four model cards and no model call
live mode shows the budget line, $3.00 of $3.00 before any request
a wrong passcode is refused with 'Wrong passcode.' and nothing is spent
own-keys mode asks for the passcode before the API keys (D-59)
one live request on the owner's keys (PMID 10173769, run by the owner) fills four cards and settles its spend

notes: The owner entered the passcode for the live request; it was never typed by the agent. The question text is not recorded anywhere (aggregate-only logging).
